$comment: Pinned external sources behind references/*.md. Written from research done on 2026-11-01; facts are restated in our own words in the notes. 'note' paths are relative to references/. 'license' is the licence of the upstream material, not of this file. excerpt_policy: link-only = cite the URL, copy nothing; facts-paraphrased = restate facts in our words; short-quote = quotes of 25 words or fewer, attributed with URL and access date; cc-by-excerpt = CC BY material, excerpts allowed with attribution; vendorable = permissive licence, files may be adapted with SPDX and Adapted-from headers. status: verified = read at the primary source on the access date; unverified = not read at source or only through secondary summaries.

sources.title: lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar: style library, page-contract capture engine, director method

sources.license: MIT (code); published renders not MIT, no reuse licence granted
